post.text: Someone told me they pay their mortgage with a credit card (with no additional fee) and get all the points. This has to be wrong, right? Does any institution allow CC payment for mortgage and not add like a 2% fee, if they allow it at all?
post.author_description: GP @a16z — Building American Dynamism 🇺🇸  — Anthropologist — Formerly Founder/CEO @OpenDNS — Lokah Samastah Sukhino Bhavantu
